GAB.note: Only a freshly cleaned electoral file, not stated digital or biometric.
Nothing on a number at birth.
DGDI leads and Thales makes the cards; who operates the system is not stated.
No register is said to be keyed on the new number.

facts.fact: RFI reports Interior Minister Immongault announced a new national ID card with a personal identification number, to be made by Thales under the DGDI, with 45 enrolment sites, FCFA 2 billion budgeted and production from the first quarter of 2024.

GAB.note: Commissariats named only as enrolment sites; no station records.
